flashcards.q: Three things called 'quantum ML' and their credibility?
flashcards.a: VQE / quantum simulation (most credible: native representation of quantum systems), QAOA optimisation (unproven vs classical heuristics), QML on classical data (no scaled advantage as of 2026; barren plateaus + data loading + dequantisation).

flashcards.q: VQE loop in one line and its guarantee?
flashcards.a: Minimise E(theta) = <psi(theta)|H|psi(theta)> over ansatz parameters with a classical optimiser; Rayleigh-Ritz guarantees every trial energy >= true ground state, so minimisation approaches E0 from above.
For Pauli-generated rotations, expectations are trig polynomials with period 2pi; exact gradient from two evaluations: dC/dtheta = [C(theta+pi/2) - C(theta-pi/2)]/2. Hardware-native by construction.
~1.6 mHa (~4 kJ/mol), the threshold for chemically meaningful energies; H2 ground state is -1.137 Ha at 0.735 Angstrom equilibrium.

flashcards.q: Why do VQE measurement costs explode?
flashcards.a: Chemistry Hamiltonians have O(n^4) Pauli terms (two-electron integrals); each needs shots scaling c_i^2/eps^2 - naive budgets reach 1e8-1e9 shots per energy. Fixes: commuting-group measurement, classical shadows, active-space reduction.

H^n to uniform superposition, then p repetitions of exp(-i*gamma*C) (cost phase separation) and exp(-i*beta*B) with mixer B=sum X_i; measure; approximation improves asymptotically toward adiabatic limit as p->inf.

At p<=3 on hardware, loses to Goemans-Williamson-class and tuned heuristics on MaxCut benchmarks; no practical-instance wins through mid-2026; promise rests on deeper circuits + problem-informed structure.

Gradient variance of deep random parameterised circuits concentrates as O(1/2^n); shot noise drowns signal beyond ~20 unstructured qubits. Mitigations: symmetry-preserving/problem-inspired ansaetze, layerwise training, shallow circuits.

flashcards.q: What did Tang's dequantisation results show?
flashcards.a: Several claimed exponential speedups for data analysis (recommendation, PCA-style) assumed QRAM access and were matched classically under equivalent assumptions; audit lesson: data-loading cost is part of any complexity claim.

Variational circuits act on inputs as multivariate trigonometric polynomials whose frequency spectrum is fixed by the data encoding - a limited classical function class, structurally explaining weak QML-on-data results.

flashcards.q: Why does simulation beat QML on credibility?
flashcards.a: Representation asymmetry: molecules are natively quantum (n spin-orbitals -> 2^n classical amplitudes but polynomial quantum resources); classical data must be expensively encoded into limited expressivity circuits.

flashcards.q: Which optimizer under heavy shot noise and why?
flashcards.a: SPSA: two function evaluations per step regardless of parameter count (perturb all parameters simultaneously with random directions); robust when gradients are noisy, unlike per-parameter analytic shifts at hundreds of parameters.

flashcards.q: Four-question audit for any QML advantage claim?
flashcards.a: 1) Tuned classical baseline? 2) Data-loading/encoding cost counted? 3) Scales past toy sizes? 4) Access assumptions stated? Most published advantages fail one of these.
